annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027
annotation.summary_en: European Commission 2018 proposal for a regulation establishing the Digital Europe funding programme for 2021-2027 (EUR 9.194 billion) across high performance computing, AI, cybersecurity, advanced digital skills and deployment. It is a funding instrument with only passing mentions of robotics; no robot-specific governance provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the Digital Europe programme with a EUR 9.194 billion envelope for 2021-2027
Five specific objectives: HPC, AI, cybersecurity and trust, advanced digital skills, deployment and interoperability
AI objective funds data resources, algorithm libraries and networked testing and experimentation facilities
Creates a network of Digital Innovation Hubs with at least one per Member State
Skills objective names robotics and AI among supported advanced skills areas
